articles.title: Niterra (TSE:5334) Stock May Trade Below Fair Value On Earnings
articles.summary: Niterra has seen its share price move sharply over recent years, which puts a spotlight on one question for investors who focus on fundamentals. Is the current valuation properly grounded in the earnings the business is generating today and is expected to produce in future years?
